name: wp-landing-page-includes-query
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] ft_landing_page / lt_landing_page store the FULL window.location.href including query string. Engine's safeOriginPath strips the query (origin+pathname only).
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (ruling #12): full href incl. query string stored in ft_landing_page/lt_landing_page. Privacy note: consent already gates storage; revisit redaction if PII patterns observed. Original note: engine previously stripped the query (origin+pathname only).
